title: link-preview/1.0/preview-request
description: Asks one of the sender's own enrolled devices (multi-device/1.0) to build the preview of a link the sender is about to send, because the sender cannot read the page itself.

id.description: Message ID, unique to the sender. The response's thid.

from.description: The requesting device's Device DID. Always present: sent sender-authenticated, and acted on only if that DID is in the receiver's roster and not revoked.

expires_time.description: UTC epoch seconds, about 15 seconds after created_time; copied onto every routing/2.0/forward so that a mediator drops rather than queues or pushes it. A builder does not answer an expired request.

url.description: The link, exactly as it will appear in the message's content.
